headline: Liquor and business license hearings, plus a tax abatement for 1089 Dexter Street.
summary: Hearings cover two peddler applications and a restaurant license transfer. Renewals for 2026-2027 liquor, entertainment, and business licenses are also on the agenda, along with a tax abatement for Pink Capital, LLC.
items: Proclamation declaring November 2026 Alzheimer's Awareness Month
Department financial reports for October 2026 (City Clerk, Fire, Code Enforcement, Police)
Peddler license for Michael Calderon, D/B/A MC Varieties, continued from October 15
Peddler license for Yessenia Rodriguez, D/B/A One Fly Stop, continued from October 15
A-Restaurant license transfer from John Chippis to Fernando Ixcoy Zacarias, D/B/A Sparky's Restaurant
Advertise hearing on 2026-2027 liquor license renewals
Consideration of 2026-2027 business renewals, including restaurants, auto repair shops, laundries, and bakeries
Tax abatement for Pink Capital, LLC, tax year 2026, 1089 Dexter St., because building permit work is valued as complete instead of under construction
